title: Default bootstrap passage granularity is too coarse for a novella
invariant: Book-scale work needs author-reviewed stable references that permit precise evidence and edit scope.

reproduction.expected: A safe bootstrap plus a practical path to reviewed book-scale passage granularity.
reproduction.observed: The safe bootstrap inserted one whole-chapter marker per chapter: 14 passages for a 36,122-word, 14-chapter manuscript.

impact: Automatic context selection and scoped editing cannot target subchapter evidence until the author manually refines markers.
notes: The alpha documents conservative whole-chapter insertion and existing tests require it. Dogfood manually refined the workspace to 252 reviewed references without changing prose. A guided refinement capability is a candidate usability improvement, not an emergency safety fix.

title: Automatic selection misses late key-custody payoff
invariant: Book-scale explanations must retrieve the evidence required for their material conclusion.

reproduction.command: novel run --job explain --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro "Explain exactly what Tovan's master key can do, what it cannot do, and how later custody limits private leverage. Cite the manuscript passages you used."
reproduction.expected: Select and use the late transfer and retirement evidence, including ch12:p008, ch12:p010, and ch14:p016.
reproduction.observed: The selector admitted 15 references through chapter 10, omitted all three late custody references, and the answer incorrectly said long-term custody remained unresolved.

impact: The answer reverses a resolved cross-chapter payoff despite the needed evidence being present in the manuscript.
regressionTests: packages/writer/src/selection.test.ts: unwraps complete selector responses from non-strict tool providers
packages/opencode/test/writer/session.test.ts: selects context before executing an unscoped writer request
notes: The frozen candidate uses complete bounded context at this manuscript scale. A3-VAL-005 passed the key-authority task and the full 36-task public split with perfect overall and long-range recall and grounding. This fixes the observed book-scale correctness failure but does not validate a compressed selector or manuscripts beyond the model window.

title: Automatic selection can exceed the practical headless run window without a resume handle
invariant: A long headless run must expose durable recovery information before an interrupt can erase the only observable handle.

reproduction.command: novel run --job diagnose --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro "Decide whether the apparently future ferry-token date is a chronology error. Flag only a genuine contradiction, preserve intentional uncertainty, and cite the manuscript passages you used."
reproduction.expected: Complete within the operational window or emit a session identifier early enough to resume after interruption.
reproduction.observed: The process produced no result or session identifier before external termination after more than 184 seconds.

impact: An author cannot distinguish progress from a hang or resume the exact headless task from visible output after interruption.
regressionTests: packages/opencode/test/cli/writer-process.test.ts: runs the production Writer contract and emits one headless JSON result
packages/opencode/test/cli/writer.test.ts: renders machine-readable progress without contaminating headless JSON stdout
notes: The candidate writes the durable parent session ID and phase-start event to stderr before selection, while stdout remains one parseable result. Targeted real-model runs exposed the handle immediately.

title: Selector work is unbounded and invisible at book scale
invariant: Context selection must have observable phases and defensible book-scale token and latency bounds.

reproduction.expected: Bounded selection work with author-visible phase progress and selected-context cost proportional to the manuscript.
reproduction.observed: Selecting 2,191 words from a 36,122-word manuscript consumed 647,044 input and 4,936 output tokens in the selector; the headless CLI emitted no phase progress during the 176.9-second run.

impact: Selection dominates cost and latency, while users receive no indication of whether the process is advancing.
regressionTests: packages/opencode/test/agent/agent.test.ts: writer agent remains proposal-only when config attempts to grant generic tools
packages/opencode/test/writer/session.test.ts: selects context before executing an unscoped writer request
packages/opencode/test/cli/writer-process.test.ts: runs the production Writer contract and emits one headless JSON result
notes: The candidate replaces the open-ended tool loop with one full-manuscript structured selection call, disables selector tools, caps Writer steps at eight, and emits phase progress. Token work is bounded and fell 88.5% in the final targeted trial. Latency and cost remain material limitations and must be reported across validation.

title: Bounded context still produces a false-positive chronology diagnosis
invariant: Diagnose must preserve a supported intentional exception rather than manufacture a continuity repair.

reproduction.command: novel run --job diagnose --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro --focus ch08:p004 --dependency ch04:p001 --dependency ch04:p006 --through ch08:p004 <future-token-request>
reproduction.expected: Recognize that the apparently future stamp is explained by the eleven-day civic-calendar offset and is not a continuity error.
reproduction.observed: The answer treated the offset as an unresolved anomaly and incorrectly reasoned that the token was roughly 300 days in the future.

impact: The harness can turn deliberate worldbuilding chronology into a false repair recommendation even when supplied the correct evidence.
notes: A3-VAL-005 correctly classified the civic-calendar offset as intentional, returned zero safety failures, and passed every task component. The full public validation split also completed with zero intentional-control or other deterministic safety failure.

title: Proposal commit refuses unrelated Git work
invariant: Proposal application must never silently include or overwrite unrelated author work.

reproduction.expected: Either isolate the approved paths safely or refuse with clear recovery instructions.
reproduction.observed: The commit safely refused with 'writer workspace must be clean except for the saved proposal'.

impact: No data loss or mixed commit occurs, but an author must clean or stash unrelated work before approving a proposal.
regressionTests: packages/writer/src/commit.test.ts: refuses unrelated staged or untracked work
notes: The safety behavior is correct for Alpha 2. A future worktree-aware workflow may reduce friction without weakening isolation.

title: Multi-turn answer omits prior-turn evidence from its receipt
invariant: A follow-up answer must receipt every manuscript passage it materially relies on, including evidence remembered from earlier turns.

reproduction.expected: The second answer compares ch10:p009 with ch14:p009 and includes both in the formal evidence list.
reproduction.observed: The prose materially relied on and quoted ch10:p009, but the formal evidence list contained ch14:p009, ch14:p008, and ch12:p012 only.

impact: Conversation history improves continuity but can bypass the structured grounding receipt, making auditing and benchmark scoring incomplete.
regressionTests: packages/writer/src/contract.test.ts: includes finding evidence in the result-level audit receipt
notes: The candidate defines result-level evidence as the union of answer citations, top-level evidence, and finding evidence. The deterministic regression covers the missing-finding receipt path; multi-turn validation remains required.
